title: Backend: Per-Client Rate Limiter
summary: Build the rate limiter that protects an API gateway: per-client fixed windows, an injectable clock, input validation and thread safety.
problemStatement:
## Scenario
Your team's API gateway needs to stop a single client from flooding the service. You are implementing the core of that protection: an in-memory **fixed-window rate limiter**.

## Task
Implement `com.prep2place.ratelimit.RateLimiter` (file `src/main/java/com/prep2place/ratelimit/RateLimiter.java`). Keep the public signatures exactly as in the starter.

- `RateLimiter(int maxRequests, Duration window, Clock clock)`
- `boolean tryAcquire(String clientId)` - returns `true` and counts the request if the client is still within its limit, otherwise `false`.
- `int remaining(String clientId)` - how many more requests the client may make in its current window.

## Rules
- Each client has its own window. A client's window **starts at that client's first accepted request**. A request is allowed while fewer than `maxRequests` have been accepted in the current window.
- Once `window` has fully elapsed since the window start (`now - start >= window`) the next call begins a fresh window. Rejected requests do **not** extend or restart a window.
- Time comes only from the injected `Clock` (never `System.currentTimeMillis()`), so tests can control it.
- `remaining` never counts as a request. For a client with no active window it returns `maxRequests`.
- Invalid input throws `IllegalArgumentException`: `maxRequests <= 0`, a null/zero/negative `window`, a null `clock`, and a null or blank `clientId` (in both methods).
- The limiter is shared by many request threads: it must never let more than `maxRequests` through in one window, even under contention.

requirements.title: Enforce the per-client limit
requirements.description: At most maxRequests requests are accepted per window; further requests are rejected.

requirements.title: Track clients independently
requirements.description: One client reaching its limit never affects another client.

requirements.title: Reset after the window
requirements.description: The window starts at the first request and resets once it has fully elapsed; rejections do not extend it.

requirements.title: Report remaining requests
requirements.description: remaining() reflects the current window without consuming a request.

requirements.title: Validate input
requirements.description: Invalid constructor arguments or client ids throw IllegalArgumentException.

requirements.title: Thread safety
requirements.description: Concurrent callers can never exceed the limit.
